reachability: Every new life is made at the school (newLifeConfig -> atSchool), in New Haven, at one of five American banks, and since the scope reset of 2026-10-09 nothing moves a life from where it lives (bankmoves.ts openRefusal's comment; homeOf is where they are). Creation's family choice (2026-10-14) changes means, not country. So a row whose action needs a bank outside the United States is genuinely unreachable in a played life, whatever family is chosen; its engine is reached only by quickSave lives abroad, labeled FIXTURE.

rows.player: Your Bank, Borrowing tab, Overdraft panel: types Overdraft Limit and presses Arrange It, or presses Close The Overdraft.
rows.path: BankLending.tsx Arrange It / Close The Overdraft -> run('bank.arrange_overdraft', {limit, perUse, accountId}) -> lending.ts command. The panel draws the form only for od.kind 'arranged'; no US bank's terms are of that kind (LENDING: Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo per_item; Citi, Capital One none), so a New Haven life sees the per-item text and no form.
rows.preconditions: An open current account (named or the primary); the bank's terms arranged; a record of ESTIMATE.scoreFloor or more; wages paid in the last 30 days; limit within the bank's min and max, less what other banks arranged; not overdrawn past the limit asked.
rows.costs: Set-up fee or facility fee on the first arrangement; monthly fee on the 1st while arranged; interest past the buffer; yearly fee a year on.
rows.timing: At once; fees and interest on the day rollover and the 1st.
rows.refusals: That isn’t an open current account of yours. / There’s no current account to arrange one on. / doesn’t offer an overdraft SLATE has terms for. / doesn’t arrange one: it runs overdrafts its own way... / The bank turns down a credit record this poor. / not enough has been paid in this month. / The bank arranges between X and Y. / You’re overdrawn by more than that already. / Pay the overdraft back before closing it.
rows.outcomes: overdraftLimit/Rate/PerUse/Since set; limit 0 clears the limit. Until 2026-10-15 a limit of 0 on an account with nothing arranged answered ok and changed nothing, at any bank, a New Haven one included.
rows.readers: overdraftRoom/overdraftHeadroom (spending), lending_day interest and fees, leftOverdrawn (the 60 days counted past the limit) -> closeForOverdraft, overdraftOffer at other banks.
rows.persistence: Account fields and fee postings, in the save.
rows.gap: Genuinely unreachable in a played life (no US bank arranges one). Evidence missing abroad: leftOverdrawn reading the limit, the limit-0 close and its refusal, 'overdrawn by more than that', render. New Haven: the refusal checked by words only. Implementation: the limit-0 no-op (fixed).
acceptance: command+render: PLAYER JOURNEY at each of the five New Haven banks, arrange refused in its words, nothing posted, nothing set, across a reload; the Overdraft panel draws no Arrange It; limit 0 refused 'No overdraft is arranged on it.' (failed before: answered ok)

rows.player: Your Bank, Accounts, Your Accounts Over Time: Cancel It beside an account new enough.

rows.preconditions: The account the player's, open, within the country's cooling-off days (UNCLAIMED[iso].coolingOffDays; none for the US); not the primary; a current account only where it could be closed (closeRefusal).
rows.costs: None: the money back whole, no interest, no penalty.
rows.timing: At once at the same bank; sent in the bank's days to another.
rows.refusals: That isn’t one of your accounts. / Its cooling-off period has passed, or there isn’t one here for it. / You don’t have a card. / Your primary current account can’t be canceled. / closeRefusal's (overdrawn, money on its way, what uses it, savings beside it, card payments pending).
rows.outcomes: Savings/term: balance into a current account at its bank or sent to the primary, closedAt, payments into it dropped. Card: closing, closed if nothing owed. Current: closed, money to the primary. Until 2026-10-15 an overdrawn current account closed with its debt, and one with savings beside it or money on its way closed too.
rows.gap: Genuinely unreachable in a played life (the US has no cooling-off). Abroad: card branch and current-account branch untested; implementation broken for an overdrawn current account (fixed); the current-account branch had no control (added). New Haven: no evidence the panel draws nothing and the command refuses.
acceptance: command+render: PLAYER JOURNEY New Haven savings opened that day: no Cancel It drawn, the command refused in its words, the account open

rows.timing: The service's working days, or a later working day chosen.
rows.refusals: That isn’t a bank where you live. / You already bank with X. / You keep an account at X already... / charged-off debt / ChexSystems / A switch is already under way. / photo ID / Clear the overdraft... / the new bank's rules / A partial switch is ... Britain only. / There’s no switching service here: ... / The earliest date it can be is ... / A switch date is a working day.
